build_quantize_model_with_aqlm: build a quantized language model by replacing Linear layers with AQLM quantized layers using replace_with_aqlm_linear
replace_model_linear_layers_with_aqlm: replace nn.Linear layers in a PyTorch model with AQLM QuantizedLinear modules for model quantization
quantize_model_preserving_modules: quantize a transformer model with AQLM while skipping specified modules like lm_head via modules_to_not_convert
configure_aqlm_quantization_params: configure AQLM quantization with in_group_size, out_group_size, num_codebooks, and nbits_per_codebook parameters
validate_aqlm_quantization_replacement: validate that Linear modules were successfully replaced with QuantizedLinear during AQLM quantization
